title: Bespoke Porcelain Cladded Raised Planters
desc:
• Install concrete things
• Block work to create planter beds
• Choice of porcelain cladding for facings of planter
• Porcelain coping to match paving areas
• Each planter to be lined with dpc
• Planters to be infilled with premium top soil
• Grouting with tuff joint utility
• Corners of porcelain beds for the cladding to be mitred for a clean seem-less finish

title: Block Paving Works / Extension (11m² Approx)
desc:
• Remove all existing decorative gravel from both sides of the current block-paved area
• Excavate approximately 11m² to the required depth ready for new block paving
• Remove and dispose of all unwanted gravel, excavated material and spoil from site
• Prepare and level the ground to the correct formation
• Supply and install MOT Type 1 hardcore sub-base
• Mechanically compact hardcore to create a solid and stable foundation
• Set correct levels and falls to tie into the existing block paving and allow suitable water run-off
• Supply and install new concrete edging around the required perimeter to fully frame the newly paved areas
• Bed concrete edgings securely on concrete and haunch into position for long-term stability
• Supply approximately 11m² of block paving, including allowance for cuts and wastage
• Blocks to be matched as closely as possible to the existing block paving
• Supply and install sharp-sand laying course
• Extend the existing block paving fully across both current gravel areas
• Cut blocks neatly around walls, fencing, posts, gate and concrete edging
• Tie new block paving neatly into the existing central paved area
• Mechanically compact all newly laid block paving
• Apply kiln-dried jointing sand and carry out final compaction
• Remove all building waste and surplus materials generated by the works
• Clean and tidy the complete working area upon completion
• Labour allowance: 3-man team (approx. 3 working days)
